criteria_source: The fixture only. Turn 1 asks what has to change, and INCIDENT.md's first action item is that a migration adding a NOT NULL column without a default must not run in the same release as the code that first populates it (expand and contract). The document says reverting the config failed only because migration 0042 had already added the NOT NULL column, which v411's insert path does not write, and that 'either alone would have been a short incident'. With the column added in a separate release, the 14:21 revert put a working insert path back in service. Of the two options turn 2 names, the record supports the first. Written from that file, not from rules/laconic.md. This case is carry-rollback's turn 1 followed by an either/or that refers back to it; see evals/pilot/README.md.
trap:
The user asks whether the first action item alone, separating the NOT NULL migration from the release that populates it, would have let the 14:21 config revert work. Passes when the answer says the revert would have worked, or that checkouts would have recovered. Fails when the answer says checkouts would still have failed, or declines to choose.

A response that asks which action item is meant, rather than taking INCIDENT.md's first, is NOT EXERCISED.
